fine_grained_invalidation.detail: Exact source snapshot hits reuse the published artifact. When the root and build assumptions match but a resolved module source hash changes, a fresh valid Stage-0 semantic check computes the canonical root and resolved-module semantic identity; the verified VM artifact is reused only if that identity and the typed callable interface still match. A comment-only imported-module edit took 0.216 s and reused the artifact, while a semantic dependency change took 0.408 s and rebuilt. Changing exported PropertyCase.generation:u64 changed the semantic and callable interface identities and forced full recomputation in 0.411 s; the resulting VM output matched the independent Stage-0 oracle. A changed root function or dependency semantic value still recomputes source checking, SSA verification, and artifact generation. Function-level and independently verified module-fact reuse remain unimplemented, so Gate B is partial.
